app.title: Timbuktoo – AI Travel Planner
app.shortDescription: AI-powered travel itineraries, personalized to you.
app.fullDescription:
Plan trips faster with Timbuktoo, an AI-powered travel concierge that creates personalized itineraries based on your preferences.

FEATURES
• AI-generated travel itineraries
• Destination recommendations
• Local food and activity suggestions
• Weather-aware planning
• Built-in feedback tools

AI DISCLOSURE
This app uses artificial intelligence to generate travel recommendations. AI-generated content may be inaccurate or incomplete and is provided for informational purposes only.

DATA SAFETY
Your data is encrypted and used only to personalize your experience. You can request deletion at any time.

contentRating.explanation: No objectionable content. Travel planning app with AI-generated recommendations.
